name: Skeletal wyverns

unlocks.name: Wyver-nother One
unlocks.notes: Extends Skeletal Wyvern assignments. The Slayer master assignment tables list the extended amount as 50-70; the Slayer Rewards page text currently says 50-75.

variantInfo.name: Skeletal Wyvern
notes: Attacks with melee, ranged, and unique icy breath.
The melee and ranged attacks each max hit 13; icy breath can hit 50+ without an appropriate shield.
Hitpoints 200, Attack 125, Strength 116, Defence 120, Magic 125, and Ranged 120.
Defence bonuses are 140 stab, 90 slash, 90 crush, 80 magic, and 140 standard ranged.
Has a 25% elemental weakness to Fire spells.
Skeletal Wyverns are draconic and take dragonbane effects, but are not undead and do not take Salve amulet bonuses.
NPC ids are 468, 465, 466, and 467 for the four model versions.

locationComparison.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
notes: Main Skeletal Wyvern area at the end of the lower cave.
Entrance is south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point; fairy ring AIQ is a nearby route.
The lower cave allows dwarf multicannon use.
Door and pillar safespots are available after the wyverns lose aggression.

locationComparison.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon task-only area
notes: Task-only area accessible via icy steps near the exit to the wyvern area.
Controlled by Steve before Monkey Madness II and Pieve after Monkey Madness II.
The strategy page notes the upper Slayer-exclusive area is a no cannon zone.

taskNotes: Skeletal wyverns require 72 Slayer to harm and 70 combat to be assigned.
Chaeldar, Konar quo Maten, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal assign Skeletal wyverns only after Elemental Workshop I is complete.
Use an elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield to reduce icy breath damage.
The ancient wyvern shield also grants immunity to the freezing effect from icy breath.
Icy breath can freeze the player; armour does not affect its accuracy, and players can still eat or drink while frozen.
Skeletal Wyverns are magically animated remains, not undead, so the Salve amulet and its enchanted versions do not work.
They are draconic creatures, so dragonbane weapons such as the dragon hunter lance and dragon hunter crossbow work.
They are one of the few monsters vulnerable to both dragonbane weapons and dragonfire effects.
They have a 25% elemental weakness to fire spells.
Protect from Missiles is suggested when not safespotting because they deal frequent ranged damage.
Safespotted kills usually require waiting out the 10 minutes of aggression before trapping a wyvern at the cave entrance or an ice structure.
The dwarf multicannon can be used in the lower Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, but not in the upper task-only area.
Killing a Skeletal Wyvern is required for the Hard Falador Diary.
They drop draconic visage, not wyvern visage, and are the only monster that drops granite legs.
recommendedMethod: Use the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon main or task-only area with an anti-icy-breath shield. Melee with dragon hunter lance is the strongest direct method; Ranged or Magic safespotting is safer after the 10-minute aggression timer, with Fire Magic benefiting from the 25% elemental weakness.
